name: Etapp 5 Ullånger-Skuleberget
description: Ullånger to Skuleberget / Naturum Höga Kusten. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Docksta service cluster / Oasen drinking water: Docksta service area. Official route text lists grocery, hardware store, fuel, restaurants and lodging; Naturkartan identifies Oasen as a drinking-water rest area with pressure tap.
notes: Current official section is Etapp 5 Ullånger-Skuleberget, but Naturkartan URL still says old Ullånger-Sköved/etapp-6 and older apps/reports split the corridor as old Etapp 6 Ullånger-Sköved plus old Etapp 7 Sköved-Skuleberget.
Höga Kusten GPX is official and has elevation, but retains old two-track split with a 72.6 m gap and localized deviations. Naturkartan GPX/API is continuous and agrees closely with current OSM.
Official distance is 20.8 km. Naturkartan GPX/API compute about 20.46 km; OSM/Waymarked about 20.4 km; Höga Kusten GPX computes 20.819 km.
A 2024 field report says current routing goes over/overlaps Skuleberget and Höga Kustenstigen; older Komoot/field tips said Skuleberget/Höga Kustenstigen were not part of Höga Kustenleden.
Section is named to Skuleberget, but GPX endpoint is at Naturum Höga Kusten/eastern foot, not the summit.
Official/facility sources list water at Mäjasjön in summer and business/service taps, while field reports and rules lane emphasize water logistics and seasonal unreliability.

facilities.name: Raststuga Äskjaberget / Gårdberget
facilities.description: Always-open rest cabin maintained by Ullångers hembygdsförening, with sofa bed, dry toilet and viewpoint over the Ullånger area. No drinking water. Carry water year-round.

facilities.name: Café Skuleberget / Skulebergsbadet area
facilities.description: Café on Skuleberget's sunny south side, with terrace/seating. Page notes nearby playground, free minigolf and Skulebergsbadet; FAQ confirms lake swimming at FriluftsByn. Business water when open; not confirmed as public refill.

facilities.name: Docksta Hotell
facilities.description: Hotel in Docksta; official route text names it as lodging with views over Dockstafjärden. Guest/business tap only; not confirmed as public refill point.

facilities.name: Docksta Vandrarhem & Camping / Kustladan, Skoved
facilities.description: Three-star camping/hostel in Skoved with service shop, café, pool, cabins, hostel, camping, service building, kitchen, common room, laundry and sauna. FAQ lists bottle refill at Kustladan service building. Confirm operating season and reception hours before relying on water/service.

facilities.name: Docksta service cluster / Oasen drinking water
facilities.description: Docksta service area. Official route text lists grocery, hardware store, fuel, restaurants and lodging; Naturkartan identifies Oasen as a drinking-water rest area with pressure tap. Public pressure tap likely reliable in warm season, but verify winter/off-season status.

facilities.name: Dockstabaren
facilities.description: Restaurant/bar with rooms and cabins; official route text names it among Docksta lodging/restaurant options. FAQ lists Dockstabaren as bottled-water source. Opening and lodging availability should be checked.

facilities.name: FriluftsByn
facilities.description: Outdoor village at Skuleberget's south side with cabins, camping/tent/camper options, restaurant/service, activities, InfoPoint and access to Gällstasjön swimming. Business/camping water when open; not listed as a public tap in current FAQ. Parking fee applies; activity and food opening varies by season.

routeProximity.context: north of Docksta/Norrgällsta and below Skuleberget

facilities.name: FriluftsByns Toppstuga
facilities.description: Summit restaurant/café on Skuleberget with major World Heritage views. Official route text describes simple lunch and waffles at the top. Business water/food service when open; not listed as public refill. FAQ says regular opening May-October; November-April varies.

facilities.name: Jacobs Stugor
facilities.description: Cottage lodging near Gällstasjön/Skuleberget; official route text names Jacobs Stugor among lodging north of Docksta. Guest tap only; booking availability applies.

facilities.name: Mäjasjöns fäbodar
facilities.description: Historic/local heritage cabin cluster by Mäjasjön with overnight cabin and unfurnished storehouse, dry toilet and car access. Official route text says fresh water is available in summer. Water is summer-only and field reports found it unavailable or disconnected in at least one 2023 pass. Treat as seasonal/unreliable water, not dependable potable water.

facilities.name: Naturum Höga Kusten / Hillside Kitchen / Skuleberget endpoint
facilities.description: Visitor center at Skuleberget's east foot with exhibits, staff, InfoPoint, toilets, food/café via Hillside Kitchen, free parking, disabled/bus parking and public transport. Official FAQ lists Naturum Skuleberget as bottle refill point and notes water taps at Naturum parking. Naturum 2026 opening: 2 Apr-21 Jun 10-16, 22 Jun-16 Aug 9-18, 17 Aug-4 Oct 10-16. Outdoor taps may be seasonal; do not assume cafe/toilet/water outside opening season except where 24-hour toilets are specifically verified.

facilities.name: Ullånger trailhead / bus station / parking cluster
facilities.description: Stage start in central Ullånger with nearby bus stop, OKQ8 commuter parking, hotel/restaurant, grocery, fuel/shop, bottled water, toilets and food. Prefer importing individual Ullånger service POIs if the app supports them; otherwise model as an endpoint service cluster.

facilities.name: Ullångers Hotell & Restaurang / InfoPoint
facilities.description: Hotel, restaurant, InfoPoint, toilets, Wi-Fi, food, parking and public transport access. Official FAQ lists Ullångers Hotell as a drinking-water refill point. Water refill and toilets depend on business opening/access.

facilities.name: Vibyggerå gamla kyrka
facilities.description: Medieval whitewashed stone church passed just before Docksta. Svenska kyrkan dates it to the late 1200s or early 1300s, with major interior from the 1700s. Parking is used for the Per Olsbo side trip. Church access/opening may be limited. Not a water source.

facilities.name: Villa Orrbacken
facilities.description: Lodging east of Docksta; official route text says it is about 500 m from Docksta toward Värns. Guest tap only; booking/opening availability applies.
